caption:
Stock market news | SEBI proposes up to 80% early payout for FPOs

SEBI introduced a proposal for an early payout framework for Farmer Producer Organisations in the commodity derivatives market, allowing them to access up to 80% of sale proceeds before contract expiry.

The facility aims to ease liquidity constraints for farmers, with corporate trading members offering it subject to net-worth and funding requirements; public feedback is open until 16 December.
